title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
abstract: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: this https URL

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical graduate course on embodied agents and robot learning, today's lecture is on Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents. Work such as CaP-X and ASPIRE reflects a growing interest in language-model-driven robots that write programs, reuse skills, and learn from execution. This paper, from researchers at UC Berkeley and Amazon FAR, asks whether a robot system can improve its shared code without changing its model weights. I see your hand, Noah; go ahead.
segments.zh: 在一门假设性的具身智能体与机器人学习研究生课程中，今天的讲座主题是“重建、练习、走向真实：具身智能体的引导式自我改进”。CaP-X和ASPIRE等工作反映出，人们对由语言模型驱动、能够编写程序、复用技能并从执行中学习的机器人越来越感兴趣。这篇来自加州大学伯克利分校和亚马逊FAR研究人员的论文提出，机器人系统能否在不改变模型权重的情况下改进其共享代码。诺亚，我看到你举手了，请讲。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what makes improving the shared system more useful than just fixing the task that failed?
segments.zh: 教授您好，为什么改进共享系统比只修复失败的那个任务更有用呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That distinction is central. A one-off fix may help one episode, but it does not necessarily help the next task that uses the same grasp or placement behavior. The authors instead revise a shared skill library and the system prompt that guides skill use. They practice in simulation, test changes across multiple tasks, and only then transfer the system to a physical robot. So the paper treats improvement as a property of the executable system, not just one successful run.
segments.zh: 这个区别很关键。一次性的修补可能对某一次任务有帮助，但不一定能帮到下一个用到相同抓取或放置行为的任务。作者的做法是修改共享技能库，以及指导技能使用的系统提示词。他们在仿真里练习，在多个任务上测试改动，然后才把系统迁移到实体机器人上。所以这篇论文把改进看作可执行系统的一种属性，而不只是一次成功的运行。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does the system learn by updating its neural network?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这个系统是通过更新神经网络来学习的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. During practice, the model weights, task definitions, initial-state distributions, and success evaluators stay fixed. The system changes its code-based skills or its prompt. It begins with 9 low-level tools, such as perception and motion control, and builds an initial library of 15 entries, including higher-level manipulation skills. A multimodal Runtime Agent then uses robot observations to select and combine those skills, much like a planner choosing tools from a well-tested toolbox.
segments.zh: 不是。在练习过程中，模型权重、任务定义、初始状态分布和成功评估器都保持不变。系统改变的是基于代码的技能或提示词。它一开始有9个底层工具，比如感知和运动控制，并建立起一个包含15个条目的初始库，其中包括更高层的操作技能。然后，一个多模态运行时智能体会利用机器人的观测结果来选择和组合这些技能，就像一个规划者从经过充分测试的工具箱里挑选工具一样。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does it get practice tasks from an existing dataset?
segments.zh: 它如何从现有数据集中获取练习任务？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A Constructor studies trajectories, videos, and descriptions from the ABC manipulation dataset, which contains 193 tasks. It selects useful capabilities and proposes related tasks in MuJoCo using a YAM robot model. The simulated task can differ from the original demonstration: organizing sunglasses, for example, can inspire a task that starts with a loaded case and asks the robot to close it. Humans check each task's success evaluator, and the task set stays fixed during practice.
segments.zh: 一个构建器会研究ABC操作数据集里的轨迹、视频和描述，这个数据集包含193个任务。它会挑选有用的能力，并在MuJoCo中用YAM机器人模型提出相关任务。模拟任务可以和原始演示不同：比如整理太阳镜，可以启发一个从装满的眼镜盒开始、让机器人把它关上的任务。人类会检查每个任务的成功评估器，而且任务集在练习期间保持不变。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the system does not simply replay the demonstrations; it creates new situations to test related skills?
segments.zh: 所以这个系统并不是简单地回放演示，而是会创造新的情境来测试相关技能？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. Each practice round, the Runtime Agent attempts all 22 tasks on 5 fixed development initializations. A separate Privileged Agent repeats matched trials with simulator state, including object positions, dimensions, and velocities. Both agents use the same deployment-compatible skills; privileged information is not passed into those skills. This gives the system another view of what happened while preserving a boundary between diagnostic information and what the robot can actually use at deployment.
segments.zh: 没错。每一轮练习中，运行时智能体都会在5个固定的开发初始条件下尝试全部22项任务。另一个特权智能体会用模拟器状态重复匹配的试验，包括物体的位置、尺寸和速度。两个智能体使用相同的、可部署的技能；特权信息不会传入这些技能。这样系统就能从另一个角度了解发生了什么，同时在诊断信息和机器人实际部署时可用的信息之间保持界限。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could privileged state make the diagnosis unrealistic, since the physical robot will not have that information?
segments.zh: 特权状态会不会让诊断变得不切实际，毕竟物理机器人并没有这些信息？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is a reasonable concern, and the design uses privileged state for diagnosis rather than control. For failed executions, a Video Analyzer compares the robot-facing and privileged traces, along with available dataset videos. It examines images, skill outcomes, perception results, commanded and measured states, and simulator metrics, then recommends a concrete correction. An Implementor can revise a skill or prompt, but proposed changes are restricted to deployment-available information and checked for valid interfaces.
segments.zh: 这个担心是合理的，而设计上是用特权状态来做诊断，而不是做控制。对于失败的执行，视频分析器会对比机器人可见的轨迹和特权轨迹，以及可用的数据集视频。它会检查图像、技能结果、感知结果、指令状态和实测状态，以及模拟器指标，然后给出具体的修正建议。实现器可以修改技能或提示词，但提出的修改仅限于部署时可用的信息，并且会检查接口是否有效。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How do they prevent a fix for one task from breaking another?
segments.zh: 他们怎么防止针对一个任务的修复把另一个任务搞坏？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They use cross-task regression checks before accepting revisions. Each candidate is evaluated across all 22 practice tasks on the same 5 development initializations. It must improve mean success and cannot reduce any individual task's success by more than 20 percentage points. A Merger combines eligible revisions, and the integrated system is tested again; if it fails the criteria, the previous system is kept. The authors repeat this process for 15 rounds, so a local repair must demonstrate broader value.
segments.zh: 他们会在接受修订之前做跨任务的回归检查。每个候选方案都要在全部22个练习任务上、用同样的5个开发初始化来评估。它必须提升平均成功率，而且不能让任何单个任务的成功率下降超过20个百分点。然后由一个合并器把符合条件的修订整合起来，再对整合后的系统重新测试；如果没通过标准，就保留之前的系统。作者把这个过程重复了15轮，所以一个局部修复必须证明自己有更广泛的价值。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What evidence suggests the diagnostic agents actually matter, rather than just more practice being responsible for the gains?
segments.zh: 有什么证据能说明真正起作用的是诊断智能体，而不是仅仅靠更多练习带来了这些提升？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A five-round ablation offers evidence: full R-P-G reached 78.2% on held-out trials, while removing the Video Analyzer or Privileged Agent reduced success to 51.8% and 50.9%, respectively. Removing both also yielded 50.9%. Separately, with the runtime model and prompt held fixed, skill-library revisions raised results from 26 of 40 to 37 of 40 trials on 4 tasks. These comparisons support the components' contribution, though they do not establish that the same effects hold in every setting.
segments.zh: 五轮消融实验提供了证据：完整的R-P-G在留出测试中达到78.2%，而去掉视频分析器或特权智能体后，成功率分别降到51.8%和50.9%。两者都去掉同样是50.9%。另外，在运行时模型和提示词保持不变的情况下，技能库的修订让4项任务的结果从40次试验中成功26次提升到37次。这些对比支持了各组件的贡献，但并不能证明同样的效果在所有场景下都成立。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And what happened when they moved the frozen system onto the physical robot?
segments.zh: 那当他们把这个冻结的系统搬到实体机器人上时，又发生了什么呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: After calibration and hardware adjustments, the authors froze behavior and tested the system on a physical YAM robot. It completed all 10 trials for each of 3 tasks: placing a ball in a drawer and closing it, folding a towel, and transferring a bowl between hands. The reported comparison systems did substantially worse on some tasks, especially bowl transfer. Five additional tasks were shown qualitatively, but without quantitative baseline comparisons, so those demonstrations should not be treated as broad statistical evidence.
segments.zh: 经过校准和硬件调整后，作者冻结了行为，并在物理YAM机器人上测试了系统。系统在3项任务上各完成了全部10次试验：把球放进抽屉并关上、叠毛巾、以及双手之间传递碗。报告中对比的系统在某些任务上表现明显更差，尤其是传递碗。另外5项任务只做了定性展示，没有定量的基线对比，所以这些演示不应被视为广泛的统计证据。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this approach relate to Aspire, and what remains uncertain about transfer?
segments.zh: 这种方法与Aspire有什么关系，在迁移方面还有哪些不确定的地方？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Aspire turns execution traces into reusable repair skills, while this paper emphasizes a repeated simulation practice loop, privileged diagnosis, and cross-task acceptance tests. Both treat reusable skills as a practical target for improvement. Here, simulation performance rose from 28.6% after the first round to 95% after 15 rounds on held-out trials. Yet transfer evidence is narrower: the physical benchmark covers 3 tasks and 30 trials, and the extra examples are qualitative. The results motivate further testing, not a claim of general transfer.
segments.zh: Aspire把执行轨迹转化为可复用的修复技能，而这篇论文强调的是反复进行的模拟练习循环、特权诊断以及跨任务验收测试。两者都把可复用技能当作一个切实的改进目标。在这里，模拟性能从第一轮后的28.6%提升到了15轮后在留出试验上的95%。但迁移方面的证据比较有限：物理基准只覆盖了3个任务和30次试验，额外的例子也只是定性的。这些结果说明值得进一步测试，而不能据此声称实现了通用迁移。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could the process scale if the library keeps growing and skills depend on one another?
segments.zh: 如果技能库不断增长、技能之间又相互依赖，这个过程还能扩展吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That remains open. The library grew from 15 to 38 entries, with 23 new skills and 66 modifications, creating potential integration and maintenance costs. Performance was also uneven: the system reached 10 of 10 successes on 17 tasks, but only 3 of 10 on towel folding, where cloth contact and changing geometry are difficult to manage. A useful next step is to measure compute and rollout costs, test larger task suites, and examine how revisions behave as skill dependencies become more complex.
segments.zh: 这个问题仍未有定论。技能库从15个条目增长到38个，新增了23项技能、修改了66处，带来了潜在的集成和维护成本。性能表现也不均衡：系统在17项任务上达到了10/10的成功率，但在叠毛巾任务上只有3/10，因为布料接触和几何形状变化很难处理。下一步有价值的工作是测量计算和轨迹成本、测试更大规模的任务套件，并考察当技能依赖关系变得更复杂时，修订会如何表现。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper's main lesson is that robot improvement need not mean retraining a neural policy: a system can also become more capable by refining reusable procedures and the instructions that coordinate them. The strongest evidence comes from simulation performance, ablations, and a focused physical evaluation; the limits are scaling and uncertain transfer beyond tested tasks. Keep that distinction in mind: a successful repair is valuable when it helps elsewhere and survives careful testing. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 这篇论文给我们的主要启示是，机器人的提升不一定非得重新训练一个神经网络策略：系统也可以通过改进可复用的流程以及协调这些流程的指令来变得更强。最有力的证据来自仿真表现、消融实验和一次有针对性的物理评估；局限则在于扩展性，以及在未测试任务之外迁移效果的不确定性。请记住这个区别：一次成功的修复，只有在别处也能帮上忙、并且经得起仔细测试时，才算真正有价值。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
